text:
Cole Caufield scored 51 goals last season and has 12 in 24 games this season on 79 shots. His goals are fine; they sit only a little above his expected goals (the quality of his chances), and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking still has him in the 97th percentile for chances from in front of the net.

The warning is everything around the goals. Montreal has scored about 5.1 more goals than its chances with him on the ice, and at five on five the team takes only 49% of the expected goals when he plays, worse than without him. That is padding his 20 points, and on-ice luck fades. Our range has him around 42 goals and 77 points. He also won the Lady Byng last season and has spent November in a public argument with officiating. Dylan Larkin's arrival may change who he plays with, and his five-on-five line is the thing to watch.
